title: Had sudden inspiration coming back from work and I came up with this.
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
Hey guys,

So it's about a tired office guy who drinks a mysterious can and flies out the window instead of doing overtime. You tap to stay airborne, but every flap uses energy, so you’re collecting cans while dodging rooftops and whatever else gets in your way. It features:

\* Tap-to-fly controls with limited wing power and increasingly fast runs.  
\* Chimneys, ducks, flying newspapers, and plastic bags that get stuck on your face.  
\* Global leaderboards showing distance and revives used.

Wanted to share what I’ve been working on. The core assets and UI theme were created by my niece, which helped create the design Bible. Astra helped with a few assets like background and some pages and UI adjustments here and there. Astra also did the coding, tho i knew the parameters and values to set since I was a game dev before. It also helped debug, get builds ready for stores and also help store pages and other technicalities in between. 

Please let me know what you think!
